resources.string: How much is moved per run, how fast, and when to stop after failures. The defaults suit most phones; leave them unchanged if unsure.
“All files access” is granted. You can move photos in ordinary folders (Pictures, DCIM, Download, Documents and more) without Shizuku. App-private photos under Android/data still need Shizuku.

Not enabled: only Shizuku can move files for now. Once enabled, you can move between ordinary folders (for example Pictures → DCIM) even without Shizuku. App-private photos under Android/data still need Shizuku.
Speed up detection while the phone is in use

When on, while the screen is on it checks the source folder for changes at the interval above (it only looks at folder timestamps, which saves power). A change triggers an immediate move, so downloads show up in the gallery within seconds. After the screen turns off, each rule goes back to its own interval.
Pause scanning when the screen is off
On: scanning stops when the screen turns off or the phone locks (saves power); it resumes automatically after you unlock, with no manual action.
Off (default): scanning continues at each rule interval after the screen turns off (recommended; pending moves can finish while charging overnight).
Move as soon as writing finishes (skip full settle time)

If the size and modification time of a file stay the same across two checks more than the interval above apart, it counts as finished and is moved immediately — no need to wait out the file settle time. Files still downloading keep changing, so they are not misjudged. Turn this off to fall back to waiting for the file settle time.
Pause on low battery / power saving mode
Back-to-back runs (start the next run as soon as one ends)
Android 12 and above: colors follow the wallpaper, so the whole app matches the system. Turn it off to use a fixed blue.
No self-check yet. It only tests reading, writing and deleting with temporary files and does not touch your photos.
Rules in copy mode use these records to tell whether a photo has already been copied; they do not track where you moved files later. Currently %1$d entries.

After clearing, photos copied before are treated as not copied and will be copied again the next time they are seen. Completed copy-mode history is cleared as well; rules and files already moved are not affected.
Could not reach GitHub. Check your network (GitHub can be unstable on some networks) and try again later.
Open the Releases page to see what changed.

With Shizuku, moves use the adb identity provided by Shizuku (which can reach Android/data); without Shizuku, the app uses the system-granted “All files access” permission to move files in ordinary folders. Checking for updates accesses GitHub online; everything else stays offline. If moving stops working after a system update, run a self-check first.
